speaker: Doctor
text: That inability to flex the fingertip suggests a rupture of the flexor tendon, likely a jersey finger. Can you make a fist with your other fingers, and is there any significant pain or swelling at the base of your thumb or palm?

speaker: Doctor
text: The isolated inability to flex the distal interphalangeal joint of the ring finger after a hyperextension injury is highly suggestive of a flexor digitorum profundus tendon avulsion.
